newsitem.title: USA: Tamoxifen may protect against fatal heart disease.
newsitem.headline: Tamoxifen may protect against fatal heart disease.

text.p: Breast cancer patients being treated with the drug tamoxifen may also get some protection from fatal coronary heart disease, according to a new study.

Tamoxifen, sometimes prescribed to women after breast cancer surgery to prevent a recurrence, also works to inhibit lethal heart disease including heart attacks, researchers reported in Wednesday's issue of the Journal of the National Cancer Institute.

In the study, 2,885 women with early stage breast cancer were given either five years of tamoxifen therapy or a placebo. Overall, the average annual death rate from coronary heart disease was lower for those who took tamoxifen, but researchers said it was not statistically significant.
However, the study's authors said the findings were consistent with Scottish and Swedish studies on tamoxifen, and stressed that further studies were needed.
